transcript: Just when we thought the season was full, Hell's Kitchen has announced that it is closing on February 22nd. As with any closure, my heart goes out to the cast and crew. Hell's Kitchen had a pretty decent run, lasting just under two years, but this does mean that the Schubert is going to be free for something to possibly squeeze in this season. It will be tight, obviously with the load out, but with the deadline happening at the end of April, we could potentially see a quick transfer of something come in and try to get that last theatre. It is definitely more rare for a show to close at the end of February as opposed to the beginning of January, so there's less time for something to squeeze in this season. Last year we saw A wonderful world close around the same time and call me Izzy didn't come in until the summer. However, if it's a show with not a lot of technical aspects to it, we could potentially see something try to squeeze in there. Maybe a play. I definitely think, though, that if there is a musical that can transfer before that April cut off, this would be a really great season to do that. We know that wanted has been looking for a theatre. This is actually a pretty decent size for wanted. The Schubert's deceptively one of the bigger ones, but it is prime real estate in that 44th 45th Street location. I Would also like to pitch that the heart should transfer this season. I said this before and I'll say this again. The one of the composers of the heart is the music producer of K pop Demon Hunters. And with the run that K pop Demon Hunters is going to have of golden winning a bunch of awards, I think it'd be prime to bring that in off of the back of the success of K pop demon hunters. But what do I know? But if I was a producer, that's what I would be trying to do. But both of those musicals have original scores, and it'd be a really good season to be an original score on Broadway. I'm just saying. I'm just saying. That being said, you have until February 22nd to see Hell’s Kitchen. or you can see the national tour which is currently running across the country.
